episodes.title: [English subtitle] Fumihiro Joyu and the secret anthrax terror plan. [Aum Shinrikyo]
episodes.description:
This is a translation of a Japanese news program from the 1990s. Please note that the original video was interrupted.  
This documentary focuses on the allegations against Fumihiro Joyu, a executive of the Japanese terrorist organization Aum Shinrikyo who escaped serious punishment.
original video: https://youtu.be/FdAPfdqyAoE?si=g4Z_GTPPJxGv6jx0
